$description: Single source of truth for the workspace_heartbeat Worker AND the freshness_monitor.py script. Both read this file. Update thresholds and add projects here.

types.cron_worker: Deployed CF Worker with a scheduled trigger. Probe /health, expect JSON with optional last_success_at/kv_last_write.
types.cron_gh_actions: Scheduled GitHub Actions workflow. Freshness from the latest workflow run timestamp (via gh CLI in freshness_monitor.py); the Worker probes the workflow's public status badge URL for HTTP up-check only.
types.pages_site: Cloudflare Pages / Vercel / static-hosted site. Probe a specific API route for HTTP 200. Freshness only from local git-log.
types.interactive_only: No cron. Freshness only from git-log on the project directory.

freshness_field_semantics.kv_last_write: Probe JSON contains a timestamp of the last KV write by the pipeline. Compare to (now - freshness_threshold_hours) for DEGRADED.
freshness_field_semantics.last_success_at: Probe JSON contains a timestamp of the last successful full run. Same semantics.
freshness_field_semantics.last_run_at: Any timestamp indicating the last cron fire (success OR failure). Weaker signal than success but still useful for detecting stopped crons.
